sources.title: Scientific exchange hygiene (non-promotional intent, reactive context, balance)
sources.note: Cross-cutting; market packs add local definitions of scientific exchange vs advertising.

medical.title: Evidence graded honestly
medical.check_prompt: Flag overstated certainty, missing limitations, or selective endpoint highlighting versus supplied papers. Invented citations are fail-close.

medical.title: Unsolicited vs proactive
medical.check_prompt: If context says reactive medical information, flag proactive product selling language. If context silent, [GAP] ask whether exchange is solicited.

legal.title: No disguised promotion
legal.check_prompt: Flag brand taglines, call-to-action to prescribe, or leave-behind style CTAs inside supposed scientific exchange.

regulatory.title: Channel integrity
regulatory.check_prompt: Confirm channel remains scientific_exchange. If content is primarily product promotion, recommend re-intake as promo and load promo rulesets.

regulatory.title: Off-label discussion controls
regulatory.check_prompt: If off-label or investigational use is discussed, require clear labeling as such and point to company medical-info SOP. Do not approve; mark human_gate_required when off-label content is present.
